rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for man-made objects rather than naturally occurring ones.

example.english: The artificial flowers are on the table.
example.jyutping: jan4 zou6 faa1 baai2 zo2 hai2 toi4 min6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person or manner that is not genuine.

example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 siu3 jung4 hou2 gaa2

rows.note: Use this specifically for behavior or manner that seems deliberately affected or forced, rather than merely insincere.

example.english: The way they are acting is so artificial.
example.jyutping: keoi5 baan6 dou3 gam2 zan1 hai6 hou2 zou6 zok3

rows.note: Use this when a situation, behavior, or arrangement feels unnatural or out of place rather than manufactured.

example.english: Arranging the seats this way feels artificial.
example.traditional: 咁樣安排啲座位好唔自然。
example.jyutping: gam2 joeng6 on1 paai4 di1 zo6 wai2 hou2 m4 zi6 jin4
